mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO temp_stock(stock_code, stock_name) VALUES(#{stockCode}, #{stockName}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_name = VALUES(stock_name)

INSERT IGNORE INTO temp_stock(stock_code, stock_name) VALUES
(#{stock.stockCode}, #{stock.stockName})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_name = VALUES(stock_name)
INSERT INTO stock(stock_code, stock_name, deleted_at) SELECT t.stock_code, t.stock_name, NULL FROM temp_stock t ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_name = VALUES(stock_name), deleted_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE stock s LEFT JOIN temp_stock t ON s.stock_code = t.stock_code SET s.deleted_at = NOW() WHERE t.stock_code IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
